evals.prompt: 帮我分析 draft/miniio 这个 MoonBit I/O 库的架构设计。我需要了解它的分层设计、错误处理策略、和跨模块的设计模式。输出到 reference/miniio-analysis-test.md
evals.expected_output: 一份结构化的参考文档，包含项目全景、模块分层架构、关键模式提炼、决策矩阵和评价章节
expectations: Report has at least one Mermaid diagram for architecture layers
Report uses file:line evidence references for each architectural claim
Report has explicit Why/tradeoff analysis for design decisions (选A vs 弃B reasons)
Report has formal decision matrix table comparing alternatives
Report has ecosystem comparison (MoonBit vs Go/Rust/Python) in design philosophy
Report has Red Flags / analysis-traps section in the evaluation chapter

evals.prompt: 看看 draft/miniio 项目的 skills/ 目录结构。我想借鉴它的 SKILL.md 设计——它怎么给 AI Agent 提供技能指引的？输出到 reference/miniio-skills-analysis.md

expectations: Report follows the 6-chapter template structure (项目全景/模块分层/关键模式/Skill分析/决策矩阵+生态对比/评价启示)
